hints.title: Major Course Mapping
hints.text: Join students with courses on major to identify all required courses for each student.

hints.title: Enrollment Verification
hints.text: Left join enrollments on student_id and course_id to check grades received.

hints.title: All A Grades Criteria
hints.text: Group by student_id and verify sum(grade = 'A') equals count(courses.course_id) and no courses are missing.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT s.student_id
FROM students s
JOIN courses c ON s.major = c.major
LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id AND c.course_id = e.course_id
GROUP BY s.student_id
HAVING COUNT(c.course_id) = SUM(CASE WHEN e.grade = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY s.student_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Grouping per student after major-based course join.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inner joining enrollments alone ignores students who have missing courses in their major.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Left join preserves unfulfilled course slots.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use LEFT JOIN and conditional aggregation HAVING to check complete major course mastery.
